'''Osted Picutorion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Picutorion was a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and in [[553 BBY]], he married [[Farasa Anturi]], a deranged [[Prince/Legends|princess]] from the aristocratic [[House Picutorion|House Anturi]], which was based in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. The House was renamed "House Picutorion" and Pictorion became involved in a conflict with two rival Senex houses, [[House Vandron]] and [[House Petro]], in what became known as the [[Crimson Days]]. Picutorian defeated the combined Vandron and Petro forces, then freed the [[Hutlarian]]s from servitude to the Senex lords and occupied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]]. The conflict was ended by the [[Third Nantama Synod]], which accepted Picutorion's marriage.<ref name="TEA" />
